top_signals.title: BlackRock’s Rieder Sees AI Helping Buoy GDP Even as Hiring Slows
top_signals.summary: BlackRock Inc.’s Rick Rieder said last month’s surprise contraction in payrolls reflects a “productivity revolution” rather than economic weakness, arguing that the US economy remains on track for 6% nominal growth in gross domestic product even as hiring stalls.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
